hazop.note: Letha amabhokisi enodi wocwaningo lwe-HAZOP lwe-P&ID (ifayela i-add-on ye-P&ID ye-CadCraft ehlinza njengamabhokisi enodi ye-HAZOP). Inodi ngayinye iba unxande oshidini elivulekile olunenombolo, igama, impahla nemigqa, luvulekile, lulungele izimpendulo zethimba. Ishidi lithathwa njengoba linyatheliswe ngobukhulu obugcwele kusukela ekhoneni lesobunxele elingezansi komdwebo; bhala enye inombolo uma linyatheliswe ngesikali esihlukile (0.5 ye-1:2).
hazop.badscale: Isikali sokunyatheliswa kufanele kube yinombolo emkhulu kuzero.

pnotes.about: Amanothi awaphrintwa, nabafundi abayinye be-PDF abawabonisi. Noma yini oyidweba noma oyinamathisela ecaleni kweshidi, ebhodini lokusebenza, iyinothi.

pnotes.scope.label: Lesi simaki siba
pnotes.snapshot.done: Isithombe sibekwe ebhodini lokusebenza, ecaleni kweshidi.
pnotes.state.off: Ungu wedwa ongafunda inothi elingasese. Setha iphasiwedi ukuze uqale.
pnotes.state.locked: Ivaliwe. Amanothi akho angasese asavaliwe uze uwavule.
pnotes.state.open: Ivulelwe kule divayisi. Amanothi angasese avuliwe: {n}.
pnotes.setup.title: Setha iphasiwedi yakho yamanothi angasese
pnotes.setup.text: Amanothi angasese abethelwa ngale phasiwedi, kule divayisi yakho. Ayikaze iphume kule divayisi futhi akuyona iphasiwedi yakho ye-akhawunti.
pnotes.unlock.title: Vula amanothi akho angasese
pnotes.pass.label: Iphasiwedi
pnotes.pass.remember.note: Yishiye lokhu kungavulwa esikhungweni esabelwana ngaso: uzobuzwa njalo lapho uvula uhlelo.
pnotes.pass.warn: Akukho ndlela yokuyibuyisa. Uma ukhohlwa le phasiwedi, akekho, kuhlanganise nathi, ongavula amanothi akho angasese. Yishiye 'Hlala uvuliwe' kungavulwa esikhungweni esabelwana ngaso.
pnotes.more.title: Vula amanothi avela kwenye idivayisi
pnotes.more.text: Bhala iphasiwedi lawo manothi abhalwe ngayo. Iwavula noma yiliphi kumafayela avulekile manje; ayavalwa ngephasiwedi yakho yamanje uma ulondoloza.
pnotes.more.none: Leyo phasiwedi ayivulanga manothi kumafayela avulekile.
pnotes.forget.title: Khohlwa amanothi angasese kule divayisi?
pnotes.forget.text: Amanothi akho asalele avaliwe emafayelweni awo. Uzodinga iphasiwedi ukuze uwavule futhi.
pnotes.nocopy: Amanothi angasese awakopishwa: ibhodi lokukopisha alisiyo eyasese.
pnotes.send.note: Ukuphrinta nekhophi ecindezelwe akukaze kufake amanothi. I-PDF oyilondolozile iwagcina: amanothi angafundwa nanoma ubani one-MarkupCraft, amanothi angasese ngu-wena kuphela. Ikhophi ehlanzekile alinalo lutho.
pnotes.clean.done: Ifayela {file} lilondoloziwe, lingenawo amanothi noma amanothi angasese.
pnotes.send.note.project: Ukuphrinta nekhophi ecindezelwe akukaze kufake amanothi. I-PDF oyilondolozile igcina amanothi ajwayelekile, ukuze anoma ubani ayivulayo kule app ayibone. Amanothi angasese awakho ku-PDF nhlobo: abethelwe kufolda ye-Documentation yephrojekthi, ngaphansi kwe-Amanothi angasese. Ikhophi ehlanzekile alinalo amanothi.
pnotes.filed: Amanothi angasese abethelwe kufolda ye-Documentation yephrojekthi. Londoloza iphrojekthi ukuze uwagcine.
